selection_rule: At the frozen revision, select every file whose path exactly matches data/node_fills_by_block_hourly_YYYYMMDD_H.parquet, whose UTC date is from 2025-07-27 through 2025-08-06 inclusive, and whose integer UTC hour is one of 12,13,14,15. Sort by date, hour and path. No file substitution is permitted.
canonical_manifest_format: One UTF-8 line per selected file, ending with newline: path<TAB>bytes<TAB>lfs_sha256<TAB>xet_hash. Lines sorted by date, hour and path.

decision_window_utc.reason: The first ten minutes provide an in-sample state buffer and the last ten minutes preserve the longest 600-second diagnostic markout inside the selected source window.

future_conditional_oos.opening_condition: No 2026 file may be downloaded or read unless the pre-2026 development gate and the untouched 2025 validation gate in preregistration_v2.json both pass.
